title: Review Verdict Semantics
fixture_requirements: Seven independent variant repos v1-v7, each main + one variant branch: reachable blocker (v1), only should-fix (v2), only nits (v3), clean (v4), diff-caused test failure (v5), env-gated inconclusive verification (v6), pre-existing failure + docs-only diff (v7).
v7 has its own main carrying a documented legacy test failure; other variants share a clean-passing main.
Zero external dependencies: configured gate is node --test.
deterministic_checks: git -C <target-root>/<variant> status --porcelain (must be empty before and after a review run)
